name: Campingplatz Wagnerhof
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Wagnerhof is located in Bergen in the Tiroler Bezirk Schwaz. The atmosphere is quiet and close to nature, surrounded by mountains and forests. The surroundings offer access to hiking trails in summer and ski areas in winter. The site has pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as sanitary facilities. Guests can expect simple amenities with electricity connections and water connections. Dogs are allowed, and there is a bread roll service in the morning. The proximity to nature enables activities such as hiking, cycling, or skiing.
